fab.tiebreak: that week's loser, then lowest scorer

waiverClear._note: THE ONE DEFINITION OF THE WAIVER CLEAR (canon rule 7). His change 2026-09-27: the period went from 48 hours to 24, so the weekly batch clears a day sooner. Every reader takes the day and hour from here — sportsbook.freshness(), the FAAB task and any site copy. ESPN's own field waiverProcessHour is 11 in an undocumented zone and is NOT usable; the authority is status.waiverLastExecutionDate, which is what `measured` records.
waiverClear.measured: 2026-09-27 12:44 AM AZ (status.waiverLastExecutionDate 1790495070241 = 2026-09-27T07:44:30Z), read off ESPN by Refinement Chat; board B-38
waiverClear.previously: 2-day / 48h, cleared THURSDAY 12:00 AM AZ, until his change 2026-09-27

mondayText._note: MONDAY'S MATCHUPS TO WATCH (v71a FIX-1, board B-92 §2): the text is rendered on GitHub the moment Monday's waivers make the rosters trustworthy (waiverClear), and sent to the flagged phones no earlier than this hour, AZ, on the Monday of the game (6.5 = 6:30 AM). The Worker never sends a verdict that does not carry its sendAfterUtc.

punishment: loser-of-league punishment set by group vote; relegation if unagreed

_teamNamesVerified: 2026-09-15 live ESPN pull. ESPN is the authority for team names.

'pack' = an ESPN logo-pack pick, i.e. a deliberate choice -> use the real ESPN asset (this is why Oliver/t7 now renders the actual Gibbs SVG). 'default' = ESPN's numbered generic crest -> keep the hand-made AZFFL crest. _displayNote: `team` is ESPN verbatim and `display` is what an issue prints. They are now IDENTICAL for all ten — Brax ruled 2026-09-15 that the emoji in his own team name DO print. The two fields stay separate only so a future carve-out has somewhere to live; do not introduce one without him saying so.

tiebreaker.meaning: A head-to-head level on the scoreboard goes to the manager with more points on his bench. The league has NO ties.
tiebreaker.notFabTiebreak: Distinct from fab.tiebreak, which is waiver bid priority.
tiebreaker.dataNeeded: Per-team bench totals from a box-score pull taken AFTER all games are final. week1_boxscores.json is a pre-MNF pull and is NOT usable.
tiebreaker.unsettledCase: If both the scores AND the benches are level, the tiebreaker does not decide. build.py refuses and you ask Brax.

tickCadence._note: gameS: from 15 minutes before a kickoff until 20 minutes after the last whistle. pregameS: the 3 hours before that. dayS: dayDays between dayFromAZ and dayToAZ (Arizona time). otherS: every other quiet hour — overnight, and Sunday and Monday away from the games.
